checks.name: regression
checks.detail: R1 (mandatory regression test #1, docs/code-standards.md:53-55) present at unit tier: test_fold_maps_d_stroke_to_d, test_fold_d_stroke_uppercase, test_naive_nfd_would_fail_this, test_no_d_stroke_survives_fold_across_dataset.

checks.name: discrimination_proof_rk1
checks.detail: Tests proven to DISCRIMINATE, not just pass. Subagent swapped fold's body for naive NFD -> 4 tests failed including both critical ones; dataset leftover asserted 8 != 0. Implementation restored byte-identical (md5 c03d43305ac989ff801d5ca2988ea3ef, diff IDENTICAL). Main then re-derived the counts INDEPENDENTLY via a scratch script that reimplements naive NFD from scratch rather than importing app.text: naive 8/20, d-aware 0/20 -- matches the plan's OBSERVED figures exactly.

checks.name: a1_corroboration
checks.detail: The 8 naive-NFD-broken product ids include refrigerator-358160, refrigerator-363108, refrigerator-363109 -- precisely the 3 products acceptance criterion A1 requires 'ngan da' to return. Naive NFD folds 'Ngan da' to 'ngan đa', so the query returns 0 with no error raised. Confirms RK1's silent-failure characterization on real data.

checks.name: a11_pure_layer_no_http
checks.detail: grep -rnE 'fastapi|starlette' app/text.py -> 0 lines. Pure layer does not know HTTP (docs/code-standards.md:14-15).

checks.name: glossary_compliance
checks.detail: grep -rnE 'def (normalize|slugify)' app/text.py -> 0 lines. Term 'accent fold' used; stdlib unicodedata.normalize call present and permitted (docs/glossary.yaml allows the stdlib API, forbids naming one's own function normalize/slugify).

checks.name: fold_single_implementation
checks.detail: grep -rl 'unicodedata' app/ -> exactly 1 file (app/text.py). NOTE: this is a WEAK sanity check only, NOT acceptance criterion A10. plan.md rewrote A10 into a function-identity test (app.loader.fold is app.text.fold) because this grep is bypassable by a duplicate fold written with str.maketrans (measured: 0 hits). The real A10 guards are scheduled in P3/P4 and are NOT yet satisfied.
